blocks.heading: We are here to help!
blocks.body: Ask us anything or schedule a demo

blocks.heading: Got questions?
blocks.subtitle: We are here to help. We will be glad to address any queries you may have about billing and pricing.

items.question: What does the Free Trial include?
items.answer: We offer a no-commitment trial, with access to all destinations and features, for 14 days. After that, your account will convert into a Free plan.

items.question: Can I ask for help setting up DataChannel?
items.answer: Yes. We’re happy to help customers regardless of their size. Please email us and book a time with us and we’ll make sure set up is as effortless as possible.

items.question: What if you do not have an integration I need?
items.answer: We would be happy to build it for you. For our Enterprise plan customers we do so on-priority. Write to us with your request at [support@datachannel.co](mailto:support@datachannel.co)

items.question: What is DataChannel managed data warehouse?
items.answer: If you wish to avoid the hefty cost of creating and managing your own data warehouse, you can use our professionally trained DBAs and host your the data in our secure cloud-hosted data warehouse with options to choose between AWS Redshift or Google Bigquery.

items.question: Can I get support for my Data Visualization or Dashboarding requirements?
items.answer: Yes. We have a number of implementation partners with Data Visualization experts having extensive experience of working with various technologies like Tableau, PowerBI, Klipfolio, Amazon QuickSights, Google Data Studio.

items.question: I have more questions. Where can I find answers?
items.answer: Please reach out to our sales team at [sales@datachannel.co](mailto:sales@datachannel.co) and book a time with our specialists. We will get back to you at the earliest.

items.question: How does your pricing compare with alternatives?
items.answer: We are proud to have one of the most fair and competitive offerings. Please visit this [comparison](/compare) page to see how we stack up against our competitors.

blocks.heading: Try DataChannel Free for 14 days
blocks.body: No contracts, no credit card. The first 14 days are on us, with free hands-on onboarding & support and simple usage based pricing.
